layouts.name: CRectangleVisual_Clip
layouts.notes: UpdateClip retains the new geometry here before forwarding it to CVisualProxy::SetClip, releasing the previous value. Constructors independently initialize the field to null in 28000.1 and 28000.3231. UpdateClientBlur selects a rectangle/window geometry directly when the native blur HRGN is absent; keep that geometry when adding the glass marker.
